thread:
Nila: Kicking off the MeridianHealth customer story + global launch webinar. Need: interview windows, final quote signoff from Head of Product, legal embargo, a single-line benchmark stat for the blog, plus localization plan for APAC (translations + localized webinar times). Can we get a publish-ready package by the 28th?

Samir: I can schedule interviews. Recommend 25m slots Tue/Wed next week. For APAC coverage, let's also offer an evening slot for their Tokyo office. @nila which day do you want the CEO slot?

Emma: Benchmark ask: run a short end-to-end latency and throughput run on their anonymized triage prompts in staging. Deliver median token latency and a one-line comparative stat (with appendix link). Need Meridian sign-off to run tests. I'll aim for a conservative line like "~2.4x median latency improvement in our tests" unless numbers differ.

Joel: Asset list: approved pull quote, CEO + Head of Product headshots, SVG logo, 3x15s social clips, and a translated hero banner (EN/JP). I can draft hero comps and local copy once quote is final.

Nila: Draft quote (for legal):
```
\"Redwood's inference speed let us move from batch to near-real-time summaries, improving how quickly clinicians act.\"
```

legal-bot: Quick guidance: add attribution "in our tests" for performance claims and avoid absolutes like "improving how quickly clinicians act" unless customer gives a measurable stat. Recommend: "In our tests, Redwood's inference speed in our environment enabled near-real-time summaries that helped care teams act faster." Also check for PHI in the transcript. Expected review 48-72h.

Nila: Updated per legal: "In our tests, Redwood's inference speed in our environment enabled near-real-time summaries that helped care teams act faster." Legal, confirm?

legal-bot: Approve with tiny wording tweak: replace "act faster" -> "respond faster" for clarity. Final: "In our tests, Redwood's inference speed in our environment enabled near-real-time summaries that helped care teams respond faster." Marking priority.

Emma: Scheduling perf run Thu 06:30 PT to accommodate APAC devs. Will post numbers + append link here after run.

Samir: Booked CEO Wed 10:00 PT and Head of Product Wed 10:30 PT. Also added an optional Tokyo-friendly slot Thu 18:30 JST (converted in invite). Included media consent checkbox and an embargo note. :calendar:

i18n-bot: Localization checklist: translate hero banner (EN -> JA), localize CTA copy, schedule APAC webinar time variant, and ask customer if they'd prefer translator on the call. Suggest additional 48h for translation QA.

Joel: I'll hold hero banners until quote + headshots. For translations, can we get a short approved copy string to send to translators?

Nila: Consent copy for webinar form: "I consent to be contacted about this case study and agree that my organization's name may be used in Redwood marketing materials; I understand leads may be routed to Redwood sales." Thoughts?

legal-bot: Recommend adding explicit consent for translations: "I consent to translated versions of this content being published." Also ensure the consent checkbox is optional and logged. We'll need a DM record if Meridian requests edits; turnaround 3-5 business days for customer redlines.

Samir: Updated consent in the invite and landing page draft. Also added utm_campaign=meridian_global and tag=meridian-case for lead routing.

Emma: Perf run results: median token latency 102ms vs 255ms baseline -> "~2.5x median latency improvement in our tests." Appendix: https://app.internal/benchmarks/meridian-1732109876. Recommending single-line stat: "~2.5x median latency improvement (in our tests)."

Nila: Great. Legal, can we include that stat with the appendix link and a 1-line methodology note on the landing page?

legal-bot: Yes, include with attribution and link. Methodology blurb should state environment, token lengths, and sample size. Also confirm no PHI in any appendix artifacts. Embargo request from customer: 28th 09:00 PT. Legal sets internal review to be completed by 25th if assets and transcript attached.

i18n-bot: Translation request queued. Need final headline and final quote to proceed. ETA for JA translation + QA: 48h after content lock. Recommend scheduling APAC webinar two hours after PT session to catch live APAC audience.

Joel: Headshots + logo uploaded to the case folder. I've started hero comps in EN; will hand off copy to i18n-bot once quote is final.

Samir: Ops routing note: utm_campaign=meridian_global; tag=meridian-case; leads routed to /queues/enterprise-sdr; consent param captured as consent_marketing=true. :gear:

Nila: Final quote updated per legal: "In our tests, Redwood's inference speed in our environment enabled near-real-time summaries that helped care teams respond faster." We're good to send transcript for legal review.

legal-bot: Marking as priority review. If Meridian signs off without redlines we'll be clear for embargo 28th; otherwise allow 3-5 business days for edits.

Emma: I'll attach the perf appendix and a short methodology snippet to the landing page draft.

i18n-bot: After translation QA, I'll post JA copy here for review.

Nila: Action list: interviews (Samir), perf stat + appendix (Emma), legal signoff (legal-bot), translations (i18n-bot), assets (Joel), lead routing (Samir). Follow-up Tue morning for final confirmations. Thanks team :sparkles:
